out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at BACK handwashing sink NEAR THREE-VAT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC ADDED PAPER TOWELS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE HANDWASHING SINKS ARE ALWAYS PROPERLY SUPPLIED WITH PAPER TOWELS.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED BLACK BEANS AT 111-120F AND GRILLED CHICKEN AT 98-100F IN THE THREE-DRAWER ALTO-SHAAM HOTBOX IN THE BACK KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC REHEATED FOOD ITEMS TO 165F+ DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE HOT HOLDING FOODS ARE KEPT AT 135F OR ABOVE AND THE HOTBOXES ARE MAINTAINED AT HIGHER TEMPERATURES.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Manual Wash Water Temperature
violations.observation: OBSERVED THREE-VAT SINK MEET TEMPERATURES BETWEEN 96-104F DURING INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: The temperature of the wash solution for manual warewashing machine must be no less than 110F or the temperature specified on the cleaning agent manufacturer's label instructions. PIC UNDERSTANDS THREE-VAT SINK NEEDS TO MEET 110F AT A MINIMUM. PLEASE PROVIDE PROOF TO THE EHS BY TIME OF FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION THAT THE THREE-VAT SINK CAN MEET 110F.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. OBSERVED Y-SPLITTER INSTALLED AT THE MOP SINK.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. PIC INFORMED EHS THAT THE APPROVED SPLITTER WAS NOT INSTALLED BECAUSE THE FACILITY DID NOT HAVE THE CORRECT TOOL TO REMOVE THE Y-SPLITTER. PLEASE ENSURE THE APPROVED SPLITTER IS INSTALLED WITHIN 3 DAYS AND PROOF IS PROVIDED TO THE EHS.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: OBSERVED NO PAPER TOWELS PROVIDED AT HANDWASHING SINK IN WAREWASHING AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. CDI: PAPER TOWELS PROVIDED TO SINK AT TIME OF INSPECTION.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. OBSERVED AN UNAPPROVED SPLITTER ON BOTH MOP SINKS IN FACILITY (IN CLOSET NEAR RESTROOMS AND IN WAREWASHING AREA).
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. CDI: HOSES DETACHED. PIC UNDERSTANDS SPLITTERS MUST BE REMOVED BY 02/24/2026. ONLY AN APPROVED PRESSURE BLEED VALVE (ASSE 1055B) MAY BE USED ON MOP SINKS. PLEASE SEE EMAIL.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. CDI: WET WIPING CLOTHS MOVED TO SANITIZER SOLUTION DURING INSPECTION.
